استقيتن (form VIII)
# اِسْتَقَيْتُنَّ (istaqaytunna) /is.ta.qaj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
# اُسْتُقِيتُنَّ (ustuqītunna) /us.tu.qiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
